# Contributing Guidelines

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the project.

## How to Contribute
- **Bug Reports & Feature Requests:** Please open an issue describing the problem or proposal in detail.
- **Pull Requests:** Before your pull request can be merged, you must agree to the [Contributor License Agreement (CLA)](CLA.md).

All contributions merged into this repository will be subject to the terms of our CLA, allowing the project maintainer to re-license the codebase if needed.
